findings.summary: Official and linked-vendor surfaces resolve the same Claudio's Table at 5441 MacArthur Boulevard NW, Washington DC 20016 in the Palisades, with phone 202-920-7500.
No official allergen matrix or cross-contact statement was found after all four required searches. Only ingredient-supported positives are retained, and empty fields mean unavailable.

The official menu labels Arugula Salad, Mixed Green Salad, Seasonal Vegetables, Braised Artichoke Bottoms, and Crushed Potatoes gluten free, and offers gluten-free penne substitutions. These direct presentation/configuration statements are not generalized into unsupported allergen-free claims or copied to other products.

The official menu describes Crushed Potatoes with olive oil and chives, while Toast displays a vegetable-and-bean description under that name. The official description controls and no allergen positive is inferred from the mismatched vendor text.

The 66-row baseline omits substantial current lunch, brunch, dessert, family-meal, special, sauce, side, and vendor products and retains six former specials plus one heading and one misspelled duplicate.

The still-linked Sicily PDF belongs to the July last-Thursday one-night event, which occurred July 30, 2026; it is retained as a non-current surface and contributes no current product keys on July 31.
